entries.name: Spatial Transformer
entries.definition: A learnable neural-network component that predicts an input-dependent spatial transformation and uses the resulting sampling grid to warp an image or feature tensor.
entries.identity_notes: This record denotes the 2015 spatial-transformer module, composed of localization, grid generation and sampling. A spatial transformer network contains one or more such components; it is not a single fixed classifier or checkpoint. This geometric sampler is distinct from the later token-attention Transformer architecture and from multiplying a feature map by a spatial gate. No normalized identity match was found across all 442 pinned AIO labels/scoped synonyms and 282 preceding native IDs/names/aliases. Full-checkout fixed-string searches included ignored and hidden files in worktree and main, returning 2 and 2 lines respectively. Every text hit was a prior candidate lead or a closely related variant lead. Ten exact AIO CLASS nodes with scoped synonyms/comments and outgoing edges and five native neighboring mechanisms were inspected. Absence is bounded to this snapshot and semantic neighborhood.
limitations: The transformation maps output-grid coordinates to source sample locations; reversing this direction changes the operation. Coordinate normalization, pixel-center convention and boundary treatment must be specified for executable reproduction. The paper’s compact formulas are not a guarantee that every framework uses identical sampling conventions.

The printed Equation6 retains sums over n,m in a derivative with respect to a particular input element U_nm. For a fixed element, the derivative is its own interpolation coefficient; the record follows the forward bilinear expression rather than copying that inconsistent displayed derivative. No author-issued erratum is asserted.

Bilinear sampling is piecewise differentiable; integer nearest-neighbor sampling has zero coordinate derivative almost everywhere and is not interchangeable as a useful localization-gradient mechanism. Cropping, out-of-bounds samples and small-support downsampling can lose information or cause aliasing. Learnability does not guarantee a correct canonical pose or invertibility.

A shared spatial warp cannot generally undo changes across feature channels or receptive fields caused by rotating or scaling the input. Translation-covariant or specially invariant features are qualified exceptions. Failure of feature-map alignment does not prove that every downstream classifier lacks invariance or that spatial transformers cannot help.

The source’s parallel-module construction has a configured number of attended outputs; it does not establish unlimited object discovery, universal accuracy improvement or negligible runtime on all systems. No author implementation or model was executed.

claims.statement: A localization network reads the input tensor and predicts parameters of a configured spatial transformation. A grid generator applies that transformation to regular output-grid coordinates to obtain source sampling coordinates in the input. The paper illustrates a six-parameter 2D affine transform, while allowing other differentiable parameterizations. A sampler interpolates the input at the generated coordinates, using the same spatial warp for every channel; output height and width are configured separately from input size. With bilinear sampling, weighted neighboring pixels determine each output value and piecewise derivatives pass the task loss through the sampling coordinates and transformation parameters to the localization network. The module can therefore be trained jointly using the surrounding task objective, without requiring separate transformation labels in the source setup. Transformation type, localization network, sampler and placement are choices.

entries.name: Residual Attention Network
entries.definition: A convolutional-network architecture that stacks attention modules combining trunk features with learned bottom-up and top-down masks through residual attention gating.
entries.identity_notes: This record covers the 2017 architecture with its canonical mixed sigmoid masks and attention residual learning. It is a network construction rather than a single attention block, trained model or generic ResNet. Named depths such as Attention-56 and Attention-92 configure this architecture; constrained channel/spatial mask variants are not silently substituted for the selected mixed-mask procedure. No normalized identity match was found across all 442 pinned AIO labels/scoped synonyms and 282 preceding native IDs/names/aliases. Full-checkout fixed-string searches included ignored and hidden files in worktree and main, returning 2 and 2 lines respectively. Every text hit was a prior candidate lead or a closely related variant lead. Ten exact AIO CLASS nodes with scoped synonyms/comments and outgoing edges and five native neighboring mechanisms were inspected. Absence is bounded to this snapshot and semantic neighborhood.
limitations: Attention residual learning uses (1+M)*T, not raw-input addition x+M*T and not the naive product M*T. A near-zero mask preserves the trunk output T, which need not equal the module input x. Residual units within the trunk are a separate architectural choice.

For the selected sigmoid mask, one-plus-mask lies between one and two for finite real logits. Immediate trunk magnitudes are therefore not attenuated; noise suppression in the source is a relative or network-level interpretation. The source’s L2-normalized channel-mask variant does not necessarily obey these sigmoid bounds.

The gradient formula with factor M in Equation2 describes the naive product. For fixed mask and separate trunk parameters, the residual formulation instead has factor1+M. It does not by itself prevent an erroneous-label gradient or guarantee robustness, gradient stability or monotonically improving accuracy with depth.

Masks are learned feature weights, not calibrated object probabilities or causal explanations. The paper’s classification and noisy-label experiments have specific conditions; detection/segmentation are proposed follow-up applications. No benchmark superiority, unlimited depth or author-code execution is asserted.

claims.statement: Stack attention modules at successive network stages. Within a module, a trunk branch computes convolutional features while a mask branch pools down to broader context and upsamples through a top-down path, with skip connections between scales. The source uses max pooling, bilinear interpolation, intermediate feature-processing units, two final 1-by-1 convolutions and an elementwise sigmoid to form a mask matching the trunk tensor in spatial positions and channels. Combine them as one-plus-mask multiplied elementwise by the trunk output. This retains the trunk signal when the mask approaches zero while allowing input-dependent relative emphasis. The source composes these modules with feature-processing units and a classifier; numbers of modules, stage widths, branch depths and basic units are architecture choices. The bottom-up/top-down process is implemented in a single feedforward computation, not an iterative recurrent feedback loop.

entries.name: Non-local block
entries.definition: A neural-network component that aggregates input-dependent pairwise contributions from positions across a representation, projects the aggregate and adds it to the original features through a residual connection.
entries.identity_notes: This record denotes the residual non-local block introduced in the 2018 paper, not an entire non-local network, classical non-local-means denoiser, fixed dense layer or a particular trained video classifier. Its operator family includes softmax and non-softmax pairwise functions; an embedded-Gaussian instance overlaps self-attention without making every family member identical to a Transformer layer. No normalized identity match was found across all 442 pinned AIO labels/scoped synonyms and 282 preceding native IDs/names/aliases. Full-checkout fixed-string searches included ignored and hidden files in worktree and main, returning 2 and 2 lines respectively. Every text hit was a prior candidate lead or a closely related variant lead. Ten exact AIO CLASS nodes with scoped synonyms/comments and outgoing edges and five native neighboring mechanisms were inspected. Absence is bounded to this snapshot and semantic neighborhood.
limitations: Non-softmax weights need not sum to one, and raw dot-product weights can be negative. Their aggregate need not be a convex average or calibrated attention distribution. The paper’s Gaussian terminology refers to its exponential dot-product formula, not a required Euclidean radial-basis kernel.

The embedded-Gaussian formula lacks an explicit inverse-square-root dimension factor and is not a complete multi-head Transformer architecture. Subsampling projected source branches does not generally reproduce the full-resolution all-pairs result or commute with projection and pooling.

Zero output projection in the stated residual formula gives identity only when all residual contributions vanish. In the source’s batch-normalized implementation, zero scale also needs zero offset to make the branch zero; later training changes this state.

Explicit pairwise computation can require a query-by-source matrix and becomes expensive at high resolution. Bottleneck width, subsampling, placement and the chosen implementation determine costs; global reach does not imply linear complexity or universal speedup. No benchmark replication, source-code execution or proof of causal interpretability is asserted.

claims.statement: At each output position, evaluate a pairwise scalar function between that position and source positions across space, time or spacetime. Use those scalars to aggregate learned value embeddings of source features, with a normalizer chosen for the pairwise function. The paper’s Gaussian and embedded-Gaussian variants exponentiate dot products and normalize each query over source positions, yielding softmax weights. Its raw embedded dot-product and ReLU-on-concatenated-embeddings variants divide by the number of source positions instead. Project the aggregate back to the input channel count and add the original feature at the output position. A zero residual branch can initialize the block as identity. The source reduces embedding width and optionally max-pools the projected source branches to reduce pairwise work while retaining the output query grid; this changes the sampled context but retains long-range aggregation.

native_neighbors.definition: A neural-network feature recalibration component that globally averages each channel, transforms the resulting descriptor through a learned bottleneck, and applies sigmoid-derived channel weights to the input feature maps.
native_neighbors.identity_notes: This is the SE component from the 2018 paper, not a complete SENet architecture or its trained checkpoints. The component receives the feature tensor produced by a preceding transformation. Its channel weights vary with the input but are shared over spatial positions within each channel. SE block is the scoped alias; the paper title denotes networks assembled using these units. No normalized identity match was found across all 442 pinned AIO labels/scoped synonyms and 279 preceding native IDs/names/aliases. Full-checkout fixed-string searches included ignored and hidden files in worktree and main, returning 6 and 6 lines respectively. Every text hit was a prior candidate lead or a closely related variant lead. Seven exact AIO CLASS nodes with scoped synonyms/comments and outgoing edges and three native neighboring mechanisms were inspected. Absence is bounded to this snapshot and semantic neighborhood.
limitations: The sigmoid gates are independent weights, not a softmax distribution or guaranteed class probabilities. For finite real logits they lie strictly between zero and one, so the immediate scaling cannot increase absolute input-feature magnitudes; emphasis is relative to other channels and the surrounding network. Floating-point saturation can reach numerical endpoints.

Global averaging discards spatial arrangement in the descriptor. Channel gating therefore does not itself supply a location-specific attention map, although the spatial feature tensor is retained in the output.

Reduction ratio, placement and surrounding architecture affect cost and behavior. Additional learned weights and operations do not imply negligible cost on every device. The source’s interpretation of particular channel activations is not a causal explanation or a universal accuracy claim. No author implementation or trained model was executed.

claims.statement: For each channel of a spatial feature tensor, average all spatial values to obtain a channel descriptor. Pass that descriptor through a fully connected dimensionality reduction, ReLU, fully connected expansion to the original channel count and elementwise sigmoid. Broadcast each resulting weight across its corresponding spatial feature map and multiply elementwise. The reduction ratio controls the bottleneck capacity; the paper uses 16 in its main experiments rather than requiring that value for the concept. In its residual-network integration, this recalibration operates on the non-identity transformation before addition of the skip path. The module has learned parameters and remains part of the network during inference.

It is a reusable component rather than a complete CNN, detector or gradient-based explanation method. Spatial-first, parallel, channel-only and alternative pooling configurations are separately assessed variants, not silent replacements of this selected procedure. Full-checkout fixed-string searches included ignored and hidden files in worktree and main, returning 6 and 6 lines respectively. Every text hit was a prior candidate lead or a closely related variant lead. Seven exact AIO CLASS nodes with scoped synonyms/comments and outgoing edges and three native neighboring mechanisms were inspected. Absence is bounded to this snapshot and semantic neighborhood.
limitations: Average and maximum channel descriptors share the same MLP parameters. The sum occurs before sigmoid, not between independently sigmoid-normalized channel weights. Spatial pooling runs over channels, whereas the channel stage pools over spatial positions.

Reversing the stages or computing both from the original input generally changes the transformation. The spatial kernel and reduction ratio were selected empirically; the pinned implementation exposes alternative pooling and a channel-only switch, which are not the canonical configuration asserted here.

Independent sigmoid gates need not sum to one. Each multiplicative gate attenuates immediate feature magnitude; relative emphasis is not an absolute amplification guarantee. The learned weights add parameters and computation.

The source’s Grad-CAM visualizations and selected-image user study do not certify causal faithfulness, calibrated object probabilities or universal interpretability. CBAM itself is not Grad-CAM or a complete object detector, and no benchmark improvement or hardware-independent speed claim is curated.

claims.statement: Compute global spatial average and maximum descriptors for every channel. Pass both through the same two-layer bottleneck MLP, with ReLU after its reduction layer, sum the resulting channel logits and apply sigmoid. Broadcast the channel weights over space and multiply them into the input tensor. From this channel-refined tensor, compute average and maximum maps over the channel axis, concatenate these two spatial maps, apply a convolution with a 7-by-7 kernel and sigmoid, then multiply the spatial weights across all channels. Thus the second attention stage depends on the output of the first, rather than being computed in parallel from the original tensor. The paper’s residual example applies the component before skip addition; the learned component also operates during inference.

The module therefore cannot directly attenuate the absolute magnitude of a nonzero input element; suppression in source prose is relative to other features or downstream computation. The learned attention computation operates in both training and inference.

aio_mappings.rationale: The method analyzes convolutional artificial-neural-network activations and target gradients. This is a direct analysis relation, not architecture identity.

source_analysis.mapping_assessment: Spatial Transformer and Non-local block map broadly to Layer. Residual Attention Network maps broadly to DeepConvolutionalNetwork and relates to ResidualNeuralNetwork, preserving the different attention-residual expression. Non-local block relates to AttentionLayer only through its embedded-dot-product softmax instance. Ten exact AIO nodes were inspected: TransformerLanguageModel denotes token attention; the named TransformerNetwork and its broad attention wording do not establish identity with the 2015 geometric sampler; SpatialRegression models spatial relationships rather than defining this component; convolutional/dense/pooling layers are ingredients, not equivalent composite mechanisms. Five native neighbors distinguish channel/spatial gates, exact attention computation and post-hoc localization.
source_analysis.identity_hit_assessment: Normalized identities across all442 pinned AIO and282 preceding native records had no match. Full checkouts included ignored and hidden files; matching text is restricted to prior candidate leads.

spatial_sampler.interpretation: A fixed input element has its own coefficient; target coordinates select source samples; nearest sampling can have zero local coordinate response.

channel_alignment.interpretation: A shared spatial permutation cannot restore changed channel identities; this is a finite example, not the full general invariance theorem.

residual_attention.interpretation: The skip preserves trunk features and does not suppress a fixed-mask trunk gradient below one.

nonlocal.interpretation: Count-normalized raw dot products need not be probabilities or convex averages; zero normalization scale alone does not cancel a nonzero offset.

curator_calculation.interpretation: Original finite examples check bilinear input derivatives, source-coordinate sampling, channel-alignment limits, trunk-preserving residual attention and non-probabilistic raw dot-product aggregation. No author algorithm or model was executed.
